title: JPMorgan Chase & Co. (NYSE: JPM) — Fortress Universal Banking Compounder
primer: JPMorgan Chase & Co. is the highest-return universal bank in the United States, pairing a 5,000+ branch deposit engine with a #1 global investment bank and $7T wealth platform. In FY2025, it delivered 20% ROTCE and $57.05B in net income. At the Nov 13, 2026 close of $346.19 (14.52x P/E on $23.84 TTM EPS, 3.22x FY25 TBV), JPM sits in Stage 3 (Topping / Pullback) with a flat-to-falling 50-day SMA ($340.42) during a market Correction. Because CMP reward-to-risk is 1.77:1 versus 4.23:1 at the $326.16–$335.05 support zone, we assign WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT (TIER_2) with a $322.51 stop.
holding_rationale: Per the November 13, 2026 consolidated US positions ledger (positions_US_2026-11-13.json), JPM is not currently held in either Charles Schwab or Robinhood accounts (0 shares). No trim or exit action is required; keep marginal US cash in reserve until JPM pulls back into the $326.16–$335.05 support zone.

holding_alerts.instruction: Deploy marginal US equity cash in 2 tranches near the 30W SMA ($335.05) and Pivot S1 ($326.16) once price stabilizes (4.23:1 R:R to $388.09).

holding_alerts.trigger: Stage 2 reclaim above Pivot R1 on expanding volume
holding_alerts.instruction: Only consider momentum add if JPM reclaims $346.84 on >1.2x average volume with 50-day SMA ($340.42) turning upward.

holding_alerts.trigger: Weekly close below 200-day SMA invalidation stop
holding_alerts.instruction: Cancel pending buy orders or exit any newly established position on a weekly close below $322.51 (-6.84% from Nov 13 close).

redeployment_plan.capital_source: Next marginal unit of investable US cash ($3,818.88 cash available in consolidated US ledger; 0 shares of JPM currently held so no sale proceeds are freed).

destinations.recommendation: Hold 100% of the $3,818.88 marginal US cash unit in reserve while JPM sits in Stage 3 (Topping / Pullback) at $346.19 during a market Correction.
destinations.rationale: At $346.19, JPM offers only 1.77:1 CMP R:R (+12.10% to $388.09 vs. -6.84% to $322.51) and sits +1.65% above its 10W EMA ($340.58). Waiting for $326.16–$335.05 improves R:R to 4.23:1.
destinations.entry_condition: Deploy into JPM equity tranches when price tests $326.16–$335.05 and holds above $322.51.

destinations.recommendation: Keep JPM on active Shortlist (TIER_2) with staged equity buy alerts at $326.16–$335.05 (note: $4,933 Sept 2027 $315 LEAPS Call exceeds $3,818.88 cash balance).
destinations.rationale: COMPOUNDER_PASS fundamentals (20% ROTCE, 8.5% 10Y TBVPS CAGR), but Stage 3 tape and 1.77:1 CMP R:R require patience for support.
destinations.entry_condition: Pullback into $326.16–$335.05 support zone with hard weekly-close stop at $322.51.

destinations.recommendation: Do not allocate ahead of JPM; keep as lower-multiple watchlist benchmark only.
destinations.rationale: Trades at 11.94x P/E and 1.28x P/B vs. JPM, but earns structurally lower ROTCE and lacks JPM's CIB/AWM fee scale.
destinations.entry_condition: Requires deeper valuation discount or clear ROTCE inflection above 15%.
